description: A digital perm makes the wave most prominent when the hair is dry, and loose when it is wet. Therefore, you can create the dry and curly look of the curling iron or the hot curler.

description: Full head color is where one color is applied all over the head from roots to tips, using permanent color to cover grey hair or changing your current hair color. You may choose any color of your choice from our color menu palette. Our stylists will also be able to pick a color for you that best suits your skin tone and eye color.
